hypothesis.text: At n=18, every global energy minimizer has b=0.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: The complete n=18 profile contains a global minimizer with b>0.

action.decision_summary: Register the distinct all-optima claim for explicit falsification. EV002 reports optima at b=2 and b=6, so abandon balance as a mandatory search restriction and compare unrestricted and skew searches at development lengths.
action.expected_information: A second precise registered claim, separating balanced-optimum existence from universal optimal balance; host checking can certify its refutation.

skeptic.summary: EV002’s complete n=18 profile reports global minimizers at b=2 and b=6, refuting the claim that every global minimizer has b=0. EV003 only registers the claim.
skeptic.limitation: The refutation applies only to n=18. Balanced-only search retains the optimum value 25 here but excludes some global minimizers; EV003 adds no experimental evidence.
skeptic.next_question: Must the search find one global minimizer or enumerate all global minimizers?
